root_cause: Mismatch between remotion package versions (4.0.522 vs 4.0.524) and Zod version (4.6.2 instead of required 4.5.4) causing validation/bundler mismatch in Remotion.
fix: Standardized all @remotion/* packages and remotion to 4.0.524, downgraded zod to 4.5.4. Ran npm install to regenerate package-lock.json, then deleted node_modules and ran npm ci.
